mechanism: RB2 creates new strong reservations at frames 820 and 823.
The reserved detection is later accepted in re-ID as unambiguous.
That re-ID accept uses learn_identity=true and updates detected geometry.
Switch rows fall, but persistent mismatch rows rise and IDTP falls.

candidate.name: causal_reserved_reid_hold_v1
factorial_interpretation: Operational parent is horizon5 plus ordinary reserved re-ID accept.
RB2 is the frozen horizon15-only negative control.
RB3 changes only the reserved re-ID action relative to RB2.
Promotion requires RB3 to beat the operational parent, not only RB2.
implementation_contract: Record the reserved detection to hidden-track owner for the current frame.
When that exact pair reaches re-ID, consume the detection and hold the track.
Mark the assignment ambiguous and never learn appearance or raw identity.
Do not change non-reserved matching, costs, thresholds or geometry rules.

hypothesis: A detection claimed by both visible and hidden tracks is identity-ambiguous.
Updating the hidden track as detected turns a safe reservation into a snap.
Holding the prior reliable box should prevent mismatch persistence.
The action remains causal because it uses only current and past state.
stop_conditions: Static or synthetic behavior differs outside the reserved re-ID action.
Future append changes any already-flushed prefix payload.
W01 IDSW, IDF1, HOTA, IDTP, FP or FN guard fails.
Any output root contains MP4, preview, overlay or event clip.
Fewer than two distinct videos improve after W03.
